name: Biological Sciences (BS)
totalCreditsNote: 120 cr per the 2026-27 catalog, plus 100 letter-graded and 105 structured credits. Confirm with your advisor.
footnote: Biology courses need a letter grade (unless offered S/U only) and a D- or better. Courses shared between the foundation and a concentration stay in the foundation rows.

sections.title: Introductory Biology Cluster
sections.note: Two courses from two of the three areas: Cell Biology (BIOMG 1350), Physiology (BIOG 1440 or 1445), Ecology (BIOEE or BIOSM 1610). AP biology doesn't count.

sections.title: General Chemistry
sections.note: CHEM 2150 is for students with a 5 on AP Chemistry or equivalent preparation.

sections.title: Mathematics
sections.note: The second course can be statistics (STSCI 2150 or 2200 preferred), MATH 1120 or 1910, or MATH 1105. AP Calculus 4-5 and AP Statistics 5 count; Cornell's STSCI 2100 doesn't.

slots.label: Statistics, Calculus II or Finite Math

sections.title: Organic Chemistry
sections.note: CHEM 1570 isn't allowed in the Biochemistry or Molecular and Cell Biology concentrations; Biochemistry also requires CHEM 2510.

sections.title: Physics
sections.note: PHYS 2207 and 2208 are preferred.

sections.title: Biochemistry and Molecular Biology
sections.note: BIOMG 3350 isn't allowed in the Biochemistry or Molecular and Cell Biology concentrations.

sections.title: Physical Education
sections.note: Two PE classes plus the swim test, a university requirement. PE credits do not count toward the 120.

sections.title: Animal Physiology: Lecture & Lab
sections.note: 7 credits, at least 4 of them a laboratory course.

sections.title: Biochemistry
sections.note: Your foundation organic chemistry must be CHEM 3570-3580 or 3590-3600, and biochemistry BIOMG 3310-3320 or 3300 with 3340 (add BIOMG 3340 in Additional Space).

sections.title: Biochemistry: Lab and Additional Course
sections.note: 16 credits minimum. BIOG 4990 counts as the additional course only with two semesters of substantially biochemical research and advisor approval.

rule.reason: Not on the additional-course list (other biochemical courses need advisor approval)

sections.title: Biodiversity and Systematics
sections.note: 13 credits: at least 7 from Group A and 3 from Group B, with at least two lab courses (marked * in the catalog). BIOG 4990 in a relevant field counts with approval.

sections.title: Computational Biology
sections.note: 12 credits minimum.

rule.reason: Not on list C or D

sections.title: Ecology and Evolutionary Biology
sections.note: 13 credits including a core course in Ecology, one in Evolutionary Biology, one in Biodiversity, and a field or lab course. Up to 3 credits of BIOG 4990 with approval (not for field/lab). BIOEE 1610 or BIOSM 1610 must be one of your intro biology courses.

sections.title: General Biology
sections.note: 13 credits: courses from three different concentrations (only courses listed there), two upper-level courses (3000+, 2+ credits), and a lab or field course (not BIOG 1500, BIOMG 2801, CHEM 2510 or BIOEE 1560). BIOG 4990 2-3 credits with approval.

sections.title: Genetics, Genomics and Development
sections.note: 13 credits from the listed areas. Up to 3 credits of BIOG 4990 (GGD research, with approval) and up to 3 credits of other biology courses by petition.

sections.title: Human Nutrition: Biological Aspects
sections.note: 9 credits from the list; no independent study. CALS students in this concentration can't also major in Nutritional Sciences.

sections.title: Immunology: Additional Courses
sections.note: 8 credits: at least 5 from Group A and 3 from Group B. Up to 3 credits of BIOG 4990 with approval.

sections.title: Marine Biology: Groups A and B
sections.note: 12 credits with at least one course from each group, plus a field component (marked * in the catalog). With BIOEE 1540 as the intro, BIOSM or BIOEE 1610 can count in Group A.

sections.title: Microbiology
sections.note: Only 3 credits of BIOMI 2900 count, even with the 4-credit option.

sections.title: Molecular and Cell Biology
sections.note: Your foundation organic chemistry must be CHEM 3570-3580 or 3590-3600, and biochemistry BIOMG 3310-3320 or 3300 with 3340.

sections.title: Molecular and Cell Biology: 6 Additional Credits
sections.note: Include at least two courses of 2+ credits. Any BIOMG 3000+ course that isn't a foundation course counts; BIOG 4990 up to 3 credits with approval.

sections.title: Neurobiology and Behavior
sections.note: BIONB 2210 and 2220 each need the 1-credit discussion (4 credits).

rule.reason: Needs a BIONB course at 3000-4999 of 3+ credits

sections.title: Neurobiology and Behavior: Additional Courses
sections.note: 4 more credits of BIONB 3000-4999 (including BIONB 4200 topics), up to 4 credits of BIOG 4990 or 4970 with approval, or BIONB 3215, PSYCH 3020 or 4230.

sections.title: Plant Biology (a): Additional Courses
sections.note: At least three courses totaling 6 credits; up to 3 credits of research with approval.

checks.title: Agriculture, Food Systems & Nutrition
checks.missText: needs one AFS-AG course of 3+ credits.

checks.title: Biological Sciences
checks.missText: needs one BSC-AG course of 3+ credits (BIO-AG and BIO-AS don't count).

checks.title: Physical Sciences
checks.missText: needs one PSC-AG course of 3+ credits.

checks.title: Sustainability Challenges
checks.missText: needs one SCH-AG course of 3+ credits.

checks.title: Ethics
checks.missText: needs one ETH-AG course of 3+ credits (KCM doesn't count).

checks.title: Human Diversity
checks.missText: needs one D-AG course of 3+ credits (SCD-AS, SCD-HA and D-HE also count).

checks.title: Data Literacy: Second
checks.missText: needs a second data literacy course, DLG-AG or DLS-AG.

checks.title: Cultural, Social & Historical
checks.missText: needs two courses from CA, FL, HA, LA or SBA, each from a different category (the app doesn't check that they differ).

checks.title: Written & Oral Expression
checks.missText: needs 9 credits of writing (FWS or WRT-AG), at least 6 written; one ORL-AG course may count.

checks.title: E3 Learning Milestone
checks.missText: needs an EEE-AG or community-engaged course, or an advisor-approved internship, research or non-course experience.

checks.title: CALS Credits
checks.missText: needs 75 credits of CALS courses (INFO counts; AEM doesn't for non-AEM majors; up to two FWS also count, which the app doesn't add).
